items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: when it opened up, it had a fellow by the -- Doc Strain brought a show out and with him, his partner was a fellow by the name of Sam Russell.

ctx.x: The Lincoln Theater was opened up in 1926 as a theater that showed a picture and had vaudeville and when it opened up, it had a fellow by the -- Doc Strain brought a show out and with him, his partner was a fellow by the name of Sam Russell. His nickname was Bylo (PHONETIC) and by far, he was the funniest man that I have ever seen in my complete life. All comedians since have tried to in some way copy him. That includes the Redd Foxes with their mugging type thing and everything. But Bylo was one of the original…
And you saw him at the Lincoln Theater.
